explore.label: Explore
explore.purpose: Discover patterns, gaps, source anchors, and plausible next moves without resolving the work.
explore.authority_boundary: WORK-only research and synthesis. May identify candidate signals for operator review; may not stage, approve, reject, or merge Record changes.

plan.label: Plan
plan.purpose: Turn a live problem into a decision-complete implementation or workflow plan.
plan.authority_boundary: WORK-only planning. May define implementation steps and acceptance checks; may not execute, stage, approve, reject, or merge Record changes.

review.label: Review
review.purpose: Audit a bounded surface for risks, contradictions, authority drift, or missing tests.
review.authority_boundary: WORK-only review. May report risks and candidate signals for operator review; may not approve, reject, stage, or merge gate candidates.
suggested_scope: changed files or explicit review packet

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.purpose: Capture the leftover learning signal from a conductor pass, bridge, dream, or work session.
reflection.authority_boundary: WORK-only reflection. Captures residue for future orientation; does not create Record truth, MEMORY, or gate authority.
output_expectations: what should change in future menus
